text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service inference-runtime — p99 latency 1.25s (>1.2s SLO) sustained ~6m. Incident ID INC-2026-1775. Link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-1775

oncall-anna: acked. jumping in. who sees region skew or deployment churn?

sre-lee: seeing a clear eu-west tail. p95 ~650ms, p99 ~1.3s. us-east mostly normal. GPU queue depth spiked around 03:08 UTC. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/inference-runtime?from=now-15m&to=now

infra-jamie: autoscaler oscillation at 03:06-03:10 UTC — several pods restarted. kube-events show batcher-sidecar OOMKilled x3. might be batching + kv-cache thrash triggering restarts.

oncall-anna: ok can we soft-reroute traffic away from eu-west to us-east and fallback to smaller model variant? want minimum customer impact.

infra-jamie: applying routing change now (should propagate ~30s):
```
rctl route update inference-runtime --region eu-west --weight 0.0 --fallback-model redwood-small-v1
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by oncall-anna (1/3).

sre-lee: after reroute p99 dropping off. still seeing client timeouts reported in logs for some embedding requests: 
```
2026-03-17T03:12:15Z ERROR req_id=abc123 write: timeout to client after 30s
```

customer-success-maya: FYI AcmeCorp reported timeouts for embeddings between 03:08-03:14 UTC; they've opened a support ticket.

oncall-anna: thanks @customer-success-maya. @pm-oliver can you draft a short customer-facing note? i'll post to #customer-updates once ready.

pm-oliver: drafting now. suggestion: "We detected increased inference latency and routed traffic to a fallback model to reduce impact. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline and mitigation details."

oncall-anna: metrics now: p99 ~260ms, p95 ~120ms. keeping page open for 15m of stable signal. followups: investigate autoscaler cooldown, add warmup for batcher-sidecar, tune kv-cache eviction to avoid thrash.

sre-lee: filing INF-4092 with telemetry dumps + proposed fixes (autoscaler hysteresis, larger sidecar memory, batcher warmup). assigning to eng-runtime.

oncall-anna: will hand off to the rotation owner after 15m if stable. closing note: temporary reroute + model fallback mitigated customer impact. :white_check_mark:
